# ghost/dialer

Google Phone app: pre-fill a number on the dialpad (never calls), read the call log, list favorites.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/dialer
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/dialer dial_number --device <serial> --param number=<number>
ghost skill run ghost/dialer get_call_log --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/dialer list_favorites --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `dial_number`: Put 555 123 4567 on the dialer but don't call yet
- `get_call_log`: Who called me recently?
- `list_favorites`: Who is in my phone favorites?
